name: HNW Investment Portfolio Review — ALT-002: Cross-Capability Cash Balance Request
description: Alternative path during PH-073: Wealth Advisor requests the client's retail banking cash balance from CAP-001 to include in the holistic wealth view and liquidity buffer assessment. Demonstrates the cross-capability async event request-response pattern between CAP-006 and CAP-001.

steps.action: Requests rebalancing recommendation with cash balance included
Creates initial ENT-048 (RebalancingRecommendation) with cash_balance_included=true, cash_balance_snapshot_gbp=null (pending async response)

steps.data: request_id=correlation_uuid, client_id, review_id, account_types_requested=[current, savings], requested_by=SVC-016
recommendation_id, cash_balance_snapshot_gbp=null, note=cash balance request in progress (async)

steps.action: Delivers EVT-101: ClientAccountDataRequested [◀ CROSS-CAPABILITY received by CAP-001]
Looks up Account (ENT-004) by customer_id; filters to current and savings accounts; assembles minimal summary (available_balance_gbp, account_type, snapshot_at). Full account history NOT included.
steps.data: available_balance_gbp=87,500 (combined current + savings), account_type=[current, savings], snapshot_at=now
request_id=correlation_uuid, client_id, available_balance_gbp=87500, account_type=[current, savings], snapshot_at=2026-04-22T10:45:00Z

steps.action: Delivers EVT-107: ClientAccountSummaryProvided [◀ CROSS-CAPABILITY received by CAP-006]
steps.data: Correlated via request_id; maps available_balance_gbp → ENT-048.cash_balance_snapshot_gbp

steps.action: Updates ENT-048.cash_balance_snapshot_gbp=87500; recalculates liquidity buffer assessment; confirms target_allocation includes liquidity_buffer=5% (£62,500 of portfolio) vs available_cash=£87,500 — adequate
Polls recommendation status — now includes cash balance

cross_capability_interactions.note: CAP-006 requests minimal account summary from CAP-001. SVC-016 must not call SVC-001 synchronously.
CAP-001 responds with minimal payload: available_balance_gbp, account_type, snapshot_at. Full account history excluded.
